items.title: Schuller Gunther — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I just talked to Alice about doing some work there.

ctx.x: I used to go there at two in the morning and find you with a pile of LPs.
I’m about to start again. I just talked to Alice about doing some work there. I did it that way, although that book has been totally ignored to death by the conducting establishment.
Why is that, do you think?
